audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 49.32% WR over 2494 games: her 1175-range root and poke own the pre-item lane, Ryze wins outright at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart read Lux/Lux/Lux/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill; content (matching packet) reads Lux/Skill/Ryze/Lux/Lux/Ryze/Ryze — rows 1-6 disagreed.
audit.why: Level 2 is even (neither has a committal threat), 3 is Ryze's punish window on her 10s Q cooldown, 4-5 and 6 are Lux's (double zoning; Final Spark makes a landed root lethal), items onward Ryze.
audit.corrected: Full phases[1..6].side moved to match content, with why/rating rewrites where the old why argued the opposite verdict (rows 1, 3, 4).

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers claim a Ryze 'passive shield' (tldr, dosFull[1].t, content whys[6]/spikes[3]/late) and content spikes[2] says Ryze can 'dash the gap' — the current passive is bonus-mana damage, no shield, no dash; Lux called he/him in 15+ fields; cooldowns field had no digit; two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: Ryze's kit file: passive is mana-scaling damage plus AP-to-mana; his only mobility is a two-rune Overload move-speed burst. Lux Q Light Binding: 10s flat, 1175 range, blocked by minions (up to two targets). Final Spark: 60/50/40s. Her whole combo keys off the root landing.
audit.corrected: Shield and dash claims replaced with mana-bulk/gap-close phrasing in both layers, pronouns fixed, cooldowns rewritten with 10s/1175-range/60s/40s/11s numbers, bleed bullets replaced with reset-loop and Final-Spark-range bodies.

edits.before: - Lux Light Binding: matchup-defining — Everything keys off the root — minion-block it and her combo never starts. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rune Prison has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Your first item flips the lane: with mana and a Rod of Ages you tank a missed Light Binding, close the gap, and a single W root chains into lethal Q-E-Q burst. Into two items your sustained damage and passive shield simply outlast her one-shot rotation, and Lux has no way to peel you once you are on top of her.
